name: codedeck-client
description: CodeDeck frontend — React UI with xterm.js terminal emulator

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:mobile && cap sync android
scripts.android:verify: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --max-workers=2 testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --max-workers=2 assembleRelease
